locale.name: package.description
locale.en:
QUIQQER Products
            The product package provides the basis for product management for e.g.             an online shop or the presentation of products on a manufacturer's website.             It brings together all the functionalities needed to manage a wide range of products.             The products are very flexibly configurable due to freely usable product characteristics and are suitable for almost all product types.

locale.name: settings.window.products.onlyProductImageAtJsonLd.description
locale.en: This setting allows only the main product image to be displayed in the JSON-LD data of your online store. Activating this feature ensures that search engines only capture and display the main product image. This is particularly useful to optimize the visibility of the selected main image in the search results while preventing the transmission of additional product images to search engines. This improves the efficiency of product display in search engine results, without compromising the variety of product images available on your website.

locale.name: settings.window.products.priceFieldFactors.description
locale.en:
Here you can set a multiplier for each price field in the system based on another price field.

Example:
Price field: Recommended retail price
Multiplier: 1.5
Based on price field: Price (Value: 50,00 €)

Recommended retail price after applying the multiplier: 75,00 €

locale.name: settings.window.autoArticleNos.prefix.description

This prefix will be prepended to all automatically generated article numbers. Optionally, the following placeholders can be used:
  • #YEAR - Current year (four-digit number)
  • #MONTH - Current month (two-digit number)
  • #DAY - Current day (two-digit number)
  • #CAT_ID - ID of the product’s main category (except for the "All products" category)

  • #CAT_ID - ID of the product’s main category (except for the "All products" category)
